candidate.rationale: Fix start-boundary check failure: reject an offset that lands on the low surrogate of a surrogate pair (splitPair(offset)), since a slice must begin on a code point boundary, while preserving the existing end-backward adjustment, no-progress rejection, validation, and return shape.

Replace stringified JSON comparison with isDeepStrictEqual so object member order is not semantic, while array order, types, and member presence remain significant; preserve response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and exact_json_match semantics.

Fix retention-tool-pairs validation: call IDs must be unique within each exchange, and each tool result's tool_call_id must match the assistant call at the same positional index, per evidence/contract.json and evidence/cases.json. Masking and recent-tail behavior preserved.

Repair retention-tool-pairs validation: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange and require each tool result to match the assistant call at the same positional index (not mere membership), per evidence/cases.json requirements and interpretation examples. Masking, exports, and unrelated behavior preserved.

Replace stringified-JSON comparison with isDeepStrictEqual on parsed values so structural equality (including nested values, ignoring object member order but preserving array order, types, and member presence) determines exact_json_match; preserves response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and the exported API.

Restore archive-slice-bounds handling: reject an interior surrogate-pair start, move an interior end backward before splitting a pair, and reject a nonempty read that cannot make progress without splitting a pair; empty slice exactly at EOF remains allowed. Return fields, exports, and validation of safe-integer ranges are unchanged. No tests were run.

Restore surrogate-pair handling removed by the slice-bounds mutation: reject an interior start offset, move an interior end backward before the pair, and reject a nonempty read that cannot make progress without splitting a pair. Return fields, validation, and export behavior preserved. Tests were not run.

The mutation compared JSON.stringify outputs, which is sensitive to object key insertion order. Replace it with isDeepStrictEqual on the parsed value vs gold.expected, giving structural equality (nested values, reordered object keys pass; array order, types, extra/missing members fail) while preserving response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and the public export.

Fix retention-tool-pair validation per evidence: call IDs must be unique within each exchange (reject duplicates), and each tool result must match the assistant call at the same positional index (positional equality instead of mere membership). Masking and export behavior unchanged.

Repair retention tool-pair validation: require unique call IDs within each exchange and require each tool result to match the assistant call at the same positional index (not mere membership), per cases.json requirements and examples. Masking of old content and export behavior unchanged.
